notes.title: A Week On
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  First off, I want to thank everyone who has purchased Cluster Dust!  A special thank you to those who left a review as well!  I'm getting really good feedback for improvements and fixes to build into version 1.2 and I will update you all soon on the progress of that.

Take care and stay tuned for more announcements in the near future!

notes.title: We Are a Go!
notes.content: After a month of work, Cluster Dust is released and ready!  I learned a lot in the process of creating this game.  If anyone has any issue, please let me know so I can fix it!

notes.title: Achievement Get!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!  I'm currently doing the final nip-and-tuck to Cluster Dust and just got the achievements implemented and balanced!

While I am trying to fix any issue I can catch, please make use of the community to let me know of anything that I should address after the release on March 12th.

Thanks!
